slides.headline: 3 things your iPhone now does differently
Siri gets an AI brain
slides.body: Apple's voice assistant now understands context like a person, not a command list. Still in beta — expect mistakes.

slides.headline: 120 security holes patched
slides.body: That many fixes means hackers had many ways in. Update today or your photos, messages, and bank apps stay exposed.

slides.headline: On-device processing keeps data private
slides.body: Most AI runs on your phone, not Apple's cloud. Your voice stays yours — unless you opt in to share it.

slides.headline: Only newer iPhones get the AI
slides.body: iPhone 15 Pro and later. Older models get security patches but the smart Siri stays locked out. Check your model first.

slides.headline: Worth the update?
slides.body: Follow for plain-English AI news that affects your phone, wallet, and privacy.
